title: Pronouns — Personal and Demonstrative
subtitle: Ic, þū, hē, hēo, hit, wē, gē, hīe.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Personal pronouns decline for case. Ic, mē, mīn (I, me, my). Þū, þē, þīn (you sg., you, your). Hē, hine, his (he, him, his). Hēo, hīe, hire (she, her, her). Hit, hit, his (it, it, its). Wē, ūs, ūre (we, us, our). Gē, ēow, ēower (you pl., you, your). Hīe, hīe, hiera (they, them, their). Demonstrative þes, þēos, þis (this) versus se, sēo, þæt (that / the).
